jobs.description:
We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location

• Stock counts

• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly

• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly

• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.

• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.

• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.

• You speak fluent Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.

• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.

• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

In the cutting room, where they process pork from farms within a 30 km radius, you’ll be responsible for precise cutting and ensuring top-quality products.

Your tasks include cutting various pork parts such as:   

•  Shoulders

• Bellies

• Ribs  

• And more!

You’ll work with precision and care, following strict hygiene and animal welfare standards, using the right tools for the job.

 

• Motivated & eager to learn – ambition is key!

• Experienced butcher? Great! No experience? We’ll train you!

• Flexible with work hours – shifts start at 3:25 AM, 4:55 AM, or 9 AM

• Comfortable with a cold work environment (~5°C)

• Physically fit – you’ll be standing and handling different meat sizes all day

• Able to go to Westrozebeke (Staden) – no public transport in the early morning!

• Speak Dutch, English, or French – we give equal opportunities to everyone!

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Do you have experience in car body repair and enjoy working on vehicles? Join a company that is one of the world's leading providers of cargo handling and storage services in ports.

You'll prepare, repair and finish vehicle bodywork while working daytime hours, earning from €17.14 gross per hour, with meal vouchers worth €8.70 and internal training.

As a car body repair worker, you'll carry out various preparation and finishing tasks to ensure vehicles are ready for the next stage.

 
• 
Prepare vehicle surfaces by sanding, degreasing and applying primer.

 
• 
Mask vehicles accurately using regular and heat-resistant masking tape.

 
• 
Polish and finish bodywork to achieve a high-quality final result.

 
• 
Dismantle and reassemble vehicle parts as required.

 
• 
Move vehicles to the correct designated zones.

 
• 
You have previous experience in car body repair.

 
• 
You hold a valid category B driving licence.

 
• 
You can communicate in English.

 
• 
You work together with colleagues as part of a team.

Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Are you an experienced reach truck driver looking for a job in Roeselare? You'll mainly operate a reach truck in a frozen food warehouse, handling incoming and outgoing goods and keeping stock organised.

You'll start in the dayshift from 08:00 to 16:30, operate a closed reach truck in a warehouse at -18°C, and receive suitable protective clothing. After a successful interim period, there's a possibility of a permanent contract.

As a reach truck driver, you'll help ensure that goods are stored correctly and ready for shipment.

 
• 
Check incoming and outgoing goods to ensure everything is in order.

 
• 
Store incoming products in the correct warehouse locations.

 
• 
Prepare outgoing goods for loading onto trucks.

 
• 
Scan products into the warehouse system once they are in the correct location.

 
• 
Mainly operate a reach truck, occasionally using a forklift or pallet truck when needed.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have experience operating a reach truck and can stack goods at heights of up to 10 metres.

 
• 
You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English or French.

 
• 
Working in the dayshift from 08:00 to 16:30 suits you. Your working hours may be discussed over time.

 
• 
You can work in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, using a closed reach truck and suitable protective clothing.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.

• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.

• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.

• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

As a logistical inventory specialist, you strengthen the team of order pickers at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel working in 2 shifts for €16,3753/hour and meal vouchers. You fulfill a versatile key position as a logistical inventory specialist, combining the physical order picking of famous toy products with the administrative follow-up of inventory and quality controls. Thanks to your sharp eye and accurate way of working, your contribution as a logistical inventory specialist guarantees a flawless logistical process.

Ready to take the next step as an order picker? Aply via talentcenter1@randstad.be or 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSAP

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience within the logistics sector.

• Good command of either the Dutch or English language.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift system.

• Physically collecting toy goods and orders using a hand scanner.
• Performing thorough quality checks on picked orders from colleague order pickers.
• Monitoring stock levels and supporting warehouse administration.
• Spotting and correcting inventory discrepancies at an early stage.

Are you passionate about #AI and #cybersecurity? Do you love working with high profile teams with a sure taste of challenge and variety? You dream of joining a fast-growing company with start-up mentality? Eager to learn continuously and drive innovation via AI while securing the digital world of our customers? Join Proximus Ada!

Proximus Ada is the first Belgian center of excellence combining artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our mission is to be the leader applying state-of-the-art technology to drive transformation through AI & Cybersecurity Solutions for the Proximus Group and its partners.

Role description

As B2B AI Translator you will help customers unlock business value through AI. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and AI delivery teams, you translate business challenges into impactful AI solutions. You identify opportunities, build business cases, and guide initiatives from ideation to implementation. Working closely with customers, sales teams, domain experts, data scientists, AI engineers, and solution architects, you ensure AI projects address real business needs and deliver measurable results. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, and a solid understanding of AI technologies and their business applications.

Key responsibilities

In your role as an AI Translator, your responsibilities will cover:

• Strategic Visionary (30%): Support stakeholders in their AI transformation by helping define long-term visions and short-term priorities. You will design roadmaps, identify and prioritize use cases based on business value, and advise on AI governance and process redesign. Daily activities include engaging with clients to understand their strategic objectives, translating success stories into compelling material, and acting as a trusted advisor on AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities.
• Project Orchestrator (60%): Lead the execution of AI initiatives, acting as the bridge between business experts and AI engineers. You will oversee data maturation, pilot projects with MVPs, and ensure solutions deliver value and operational excellence. Your daily tasks involve facilitating workshops, translating business needs into technical specifications, collaborating with technical teams, monitoring project KPIs, and ensuring AI adoption in production.
• Innovative Thinker (10%): Contribute to the team’s evolution by exploring new methodologies, technologies, and industry trends. This includes staying informed about the AI market, driving innovation, and introducing fresh ideas or best practices to improve our approach and solutions.

Profile

• You own a master’s degree in business engineering, computer science, data science, economics, or a related field.
• You have 3-5 years of experience in translating business needs into technology-driven solutions.
• You have a customer-centric mindset with a passion for solving business problems, excellence and innovation.
• You enjoy being at the forefront of change, questioning the way things are done, rethinking processes and have a natural curiosity, picking up new information quickly.
• Experience in B2B environments and consulting roles is a big plus.
Tech skills

• You have a great interest in all domains of AI (Gen AI, Agentic AI, Classical AI) and deep understanding of its possibilities & limitations.
• You possess a sharp, analytical mind with a foundation in statistics.
• You are familiar with AI platforms and ecosystems such as Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Databricks, or similar technologies.
• You understand the fundamentals of data, including data quality, governance and analytics.
• You have experience creating business cases, value assessments, and ROI analyses for technology initiatives.
• You master PowerPoint and can prepare inspiring & convincing executive presentations, solution proposals, and customer-facing documentation.
• Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, and relevant regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) is a big plus.
Soft skills

• You excel in communication, storytelling and you can explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audience, both in writing and speaking.
• You can motivate and inspire others, and you're skilled at fostering collaboration across functional teams without direct authority and taking the lead on new projects.
• You have strong facilitation and workshop management capabilities.
• You have a strategic thinking mindset combined with pragmatism and execution focus.
• You work well independently and like to take initiative.
• You're equally comfortable communicating with top-level management and experts, and you know how to build a network of support.
• You are at ease with uncertainty, ambiguity and fast-evolving environments.
• You are a native Dutch speaker and fluent in English (mandatory). Being trilingual is a big plus

Our client is a well-established retail organization with a significant presence across Belgium and the Netherlands. Operating a large network of stores, the company serves thousands of customers daily and places technology at the heart of its operational success.As part of an ambitious digital transformation strategy, the organization continuously invests in the modernization of its retail ecosystem, including store operations, customer-facing technologies, and omnichannel capabilities. Technology teams work closely with the business to deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, support growth, and enhance the customer journey.

They are looking for a new Business Consultant focused on Point-of-Sale (POS) systems.

As Business Consultant POS Systems, you will act as the main interface between business stakeholders, store operations teams, external vendors, and IT departments. Your objective will be to ensure the optimal performance, evolution, and support of the organization's Point-of-Sale ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
• Advising stakeholders on system capabilities and process improvement opportunities.
• Documenting business processes, functional requirements, and system enhancements.
• Coordinating change requests, incidents, and developments with external technology partners and vendors.
• Ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of delivered solutions.
• Creating, maintaining, and executing system, integration, and functional test scenarios.
• Supporting business users during testing phases, deployments, and go-live activities.
• Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on innovation, process optimization, and store modernization.
• Configuring and maintaining existing retail applications and POS-related systems.
• Providing second- and third-line application support for complex incidents and operational issues.
• Driving collaboration across technical and non-technical teams to deliver effective and sustainable solutions.
• Identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and enhance the in-store customer experience.

The successful candidate combines strong analytical skills with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, capable of translating operational needs into effective IT solutions.You are likely to bring:

• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of education and experience.
• At least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Application Manager, Business Consultant, or in a similar role.
• Previous experience working with retail, Point-of-Sale (POS), omnichannel, or store operations systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to work.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• The ability to engage with both technical and business audiences.
• A proactive, service-oriented, and customer-focused attitude.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is considered a strong asset.
• A solid understanding of retail processes and the impact of technology on store operations and customer experience.
• Experience with SAP or related enterprise applications would be considered an advantage.
The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys managing multiple stakeholders, and is motivated by delivering tangible business impact through technology

jobs.occupation: IT Manager | Infrastructure, Cybersecurity & IT Governance
jobs.description:
Lead IT operations, security and infrastructure in an international environment where your impact truly matters.

Our partner is an international organisation operating in a dynamic and demanding business environment. As part of its continued development, the company is looking for anIT Managerto oversee its IT operations, infrastructure and security framework.

This is a great opportunity to join an international organisation, collaborate with different stakeholders and take ownership of key IT and operational resilience matters.

The X-factor?An international working environment offering exposure to diverse business activities, stakeholders and challenges.
IT Manager - Your Role
• IT Infrastructure & Operations:Oversee the company's IT infrastructure and outsourced IT services, acting as the main point of contact for external IT partners.
• Cybersecurity:Monitor IT security, identify potential vulnerabilities and oversee measures to prevent cyber threats, fraud and operational incidents.
• Risk Management:Identify, assess and monitor operational and IT-related risks, ensuring appropriate procedures and controls are in place.
• Audit & Compliance:Coordinate IT and security audits, follow up on corrective actions and contribute to compliance withDORArequirements.
• Reporting & Stakeholder Management:Provide regular updates to management, communicate key risks and coordinate internal and external stakeholders.
• Administrative Follow-up:Ensure proper administrative coordination and documentation related to IT activities and ongoing assignments.
IT Manager - Your Profile
• Up to10 years of professional experiencein IT, infrastructure, IT operations or a similar position.
• A broad understanding ofIT security, operational risks and infrastructure management.
• Familiarity with Windows environments, SaaS solutions and internally developed applications.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to present technical matters clearly to senior management.
• English and French speaker.
• A proactive, versatile and hands-on professional looking for along-term opportunity.

Turn business questions and data into practical AI solutions. As a Junior AI Engineer, you will combine data analysis, machine learning and modern AI engineering to generate reliable business insights and build scalable applications. You will work with business and domain experts to understand their needs, explore and validate data, communicate clear recommendations, and help translate promising ideas into production-ready solutions.

The role has three complementary pillars: Data Analysis & Business Insights, Machine Learning & Generative AI, and Software & Cloud Engineering. You will receive guidance while progressively taking ownership of analytical, development, testing, deployment and documentation activities.
1. Data Analysis & Business Insights
• Use SQL and Python to explore, combine, clean, filter and validate data and answer business questions in a reliable, repeatable way.
• Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, correlations, anomalies and data-quality issues.
• Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
• Apply statistical methods and effective visualizations to validate findings and communicate them clearly.
• Independently investigate unfamiliar datasets, ask the right questions and select an appropriate analytical or machine-learning approach.
• Explain evidence, model drivers, reliability, assumptions, limitations and potential bias to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Produce concise analytical notes that document conclusions, limitations and actionable recommendations.
• Work closely with domain experts to gather context, respectfully challenge assumptions, validate conclusions and document decisions.2. Machine Learning & Generative AI
• Build, test and explain practical machine-learning solutions, including regression, classification, clustering and similarity analysis.
• Use anomaly-detection and forecasting techniques to identify unusual patterns and estimate future outcomes.
• Contribute to Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and basic agentic workflows.
• Assess the quality and suitability of AI outputs using appropriate evaluation methods and business criteria.
• Prototype and validate AI solutions with business stakeholders before further industrialization.3. Software & Cloud Engineering
• Develop maintainable Python components and contribute to reliable AI applications.
• Contribute to deploying, monitoring and maintaining AI solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure.
• Apply software-engineering, DevOps and MLOps practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD and reproducible experimentation.
• Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers and business experts throughout the solution lifecycle.
• Create clear technical documentation and contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Your profile:
• Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience. Internships, academic projects and personal AI or data projects are valued.
• Good foundation in Python and common data-analysis or machine-learning libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
• Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing structured datasets.
• Understanding of statistics, data validation, machine learning and effective data visualization.
• Strong interest in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and modern AI architectures.
• Ability to connect analytical findings to business questions and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.Technologies you may work with
• Python, SQL, pandas, scikit-learn and data-visualization libraries.
• LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI.
• Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Search, vector databases, graph databases and knowledge graphs.
• Databricks, including catalogue structures and AI/ML capabilities.
• Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines and MLflow.What will help you succeed
• Business curiosity: you seek to understand the underlying business question before selecting a technical approach.
• Critical thinking: you check assumptions, explore alternative explanations and validate conclusions against evidence.
• Problem solving: you can structure ambiguous problems and learn unfamiliar technologies or datasets quickly.
• Collaboration: you work constructively with engineering, data and business colleagues.
• Communication: you document your work clearly and adapt explanations to the audience.
• Quality and ownership: you test your work, pay attention to detail, ask for support when needed and follow through on commitments.
You do not need to master every technology listed above. We are looking for strong analytical and technical fundamentals, hands-on curiosity and the ability to learn and grow in a supportive team environment.

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.
